parsed.why: No criminalisation of trans identity, but documented border-officer mockery of a trans traveller with no recourse, state censorship of LGBT expression and no protective machinery; no violence pattern documented. Elevated risk.

Working courts, recognition floor, anti-discrimination and a transfemicide law plus visible Pride and a third-gender tradition, offset by documented police abuse and killings with impunity; counts lack denominators.

Live 'deception as to true sex' and 10-year sodomy offences, unenforced and undocumented in practice; no recognition or recourse; one activist murder in a tiny jurisdiction; traditionally supportive third-gender culture.

No criminalisation, but a documented pattern of assaults, murders and police-as-perpetrator harassment with impunity and cultural acceptance; gender-identity protection limited to a health-care resolution; recourse weak.

Criminalised same-sex conduct reaching trans women with male documents, documented state torture and psychiatric confinement, no civil society or recourse, no recognition; the state is the perpetrator.
